雄心不老的少年哟，在《Just Ride》手游里，驾驶你心爱的摩托，超越速度，释放激情驰骋吧，让我们一同追逐光一般的速度与梦想吧！

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33118421/3e0e3fde369c61be9f06469533e2a52e1891152f.jpg[/img]


[b][h3]◆极致驾驶，极速体验[/h3][/b]
集陀螺仪操控、虚拟摇杆操控、按键操控这三种操控方式于一身，《Just Ride》在操控易上手的基础上，我们还将为您提供细腻的操控手感，除了可以感受不同类型摩托车的动力、刹车、抓地力、重量、风阻等操控感受以外，还可感受压车、锁死、打滑、尾流等摩托车不同驾驶状态下的操作感，再加上精心设计的视觉和声音效果，每一次加速、漂移和超车都会让您仿佛置身于真实赛道之上。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33118421/d91f7ab9bd6057109367376f0eeda1dcf670b167.jpg[/img]


[b][h3]◆无限地图，身临其境，冒险无限[/h3][/b]
《Just Ride》运用优秀的渲染技术打造，为移动端带来高品质竞速游戏画面体验。通过高精度建模和还原的车辆材质，每辆摩托车都栩栩如生。游戏支持24小时光照变化，让您在游戏中亲身感受昼夜交替的美妙。同时，复杂的天气系统包括晴天、大雾、雨天和下雪等实时变化，为您带来更加逼真的挑战。极致优化技术使得画面质量大幅提升的同时，性能消耗也得到了降低。配以先进的音效技术，游戏中的摩托车驾驶音效将让您身临其境。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33118421/bfa8777f63fa54c0d16b37ea04fa2c68ff2a3a1f.jpg[/img]
进入《JustRide》，您将获得一个拟真而又超脱现实的无限地图世界。无论是闪耀的城市街道、崎岖的山区还是广袤的荒野，每个地方都充满挑战与机遇。白天或黑夜，晴朗或恶劣天气，都无法阻挡您与好友们一同驰骋在这个无尽的竞速世界中！


[b][h3]◆奢华车库，随心DIY[/h3][/b]
在《JustRide》中，您将成为真正的摩托车大师。通过自由的定制系统，您可以根据个人喜好调整摩托车的外观风格和性能。从细节到整体，每一辆摩托都可以完全符合您的审美标准。追求极致速度？还是更注重操控性能？无论选择何种风格，您都能打造出引人注目且卓越的座驾！

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33118421/1dfc1be104c496c9f23e8b0134fc4fca7c13cdca.jpg[/img]
《JustRide》将提供超多超酷摩托车供玩家选择并进行自定义装扮，在装扮之余，游戏还提供了高级属性的改进选项，包括减重和减风阻，以进一步提升摩托车的性能表现。此外，游戏中还将提供多种各不相同的贴纸和喷漆选项，让您可以个性化定制自己的摩托车外观。只要您的想象力足够丰富，任何独特的个人风格都能得到彰显，带来更加个性化和强大的驾驶体验。尽情探索和发展您的摩托车，打造速度与颜值兼具的座驾，成为速度世界的领军人物！

无论您是追求刺激挑战还是放松休闲，都能在《Just Ride》里找到属于你的摩托车驾驶乐趣，赶紧点击下方链接，在车队里占下你的一席之地吧！

notes.title: 《Just Ride VR》 On The Way
notes.notes:
Hi,
Long time no see for all of you gamers.

It's us, HorusGames - a small indie game studio in China.

It's been quite a while since we've been on the scene, so we've probably been forgotten about.

We haven't been idle for a while, but we've been doing some interesting things, especially seeing the recent emergence of excellent domestic indie games, like the recent "Ghostly Eight", "Dyson Ball Project" and "Smoke and Fire", which are all excellent works and have achieved good results, which makes us very encouraged. The ability of domestic games to be both good and popular is attributed to the support of domestic players for good games. At the same time, these excellent games are also worthy of our game practitioners to taste and learn properly.


This time not much voice, are we touching the fish to go?


And no!


We have been working hard on our own games during this silent period, so we won't come empty-handed once in a while, so we'd like to share with you the progress of our "fishing" during this period, including the optimization and continuation of the original game, the development of new works, and even the port of the VR version of Just Ride! And all of these contents will meet with you one by one in the near future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33118421/432306b40163c5818fb600aa7a0834b9fcb3fc83.jpg[/img]

First of all the progress status of the part of our self-developed game "Just Ride".

After such a long time of silence for us, it is still being updated non-stop to make it more complete. We have completely upgraded the underlying engine, and now the graphics and optimization are substantially better than before, and the overall experience is much better.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33118421/230284df5d0c9d4167d855d919817dbe649e2465.jpg[/img]

The next plan to add more realistic "violent motorcycle" play, and will be launched in the PC version and VR version of the same time, there will be online mode will also be launched simultaneously between the two versions to support the version of the interconnection.


As the initial design of the game is compatible with VR, careful players may notice when playing, the game's overall UI and lenses were originally adapted for VR, and then to complete the main content of the game as soon as possible, the VR work is temporarily shelved. But what should be done still has to be done, after a year-long studio "love power", we can finally say, "Just Ride" VR version will meet with you sometime in 2021!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33118421/ee124fb9e937787f41612ebabb3391c838fd60a3.png[/img]

The following video is a demo of the VR version of Just Ride:.

[url=https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1NN411R774]Domestic independent game "Just Ride" VR version Demo live demo[/url]

Then, then, during the annual holiday, of course, is the time for the inevitable discount benefits!


[b]From February 10 to February 24, we will have a 14-day discount offer, discount -35%.

And!!!

Players who buy the game before March 1 will get Just Ride VR for free[/b]!


So then again, Just Ride VR we (expect) to go live in the first half of this year.



There's also a multiplayer online game that we're developing independently that's still in production, but because it's so big, we're going to keep developing it for a while, and then we'll gradually fill it up and release the news. Please look forward to it!

The road of independent games is not easy, we have been on the road, with love, only your support, we can go farther.

We hope you will pay more attention, support and spread the word about our game!

Finally, I wish you all a good  New Year!
